optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Customer Success Manager, Analytics Software Accounts

professionalSummary.text: Runs quarterly business reviews with each account under the team's review format.
professionalSummary.witness: Customer success manager at an analytics software company for three years, running the quarterly business reviews for a book of twenty-two mid-market accounts under the team's review format.

experienceHighlights.text: Presented the adoption findings and recommendations to the accounts' executives in each review.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented the adoption findings and recommendations to the accounts' executives in each review; the review records carry the attendees and the actions agreed, and the customer executives' post-review survey scored the presentations at or above the team average in every quarter.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Tracked adoption against each account's success plan in the customer success platform.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Tracked adoption against each account's success plan in the customer success platform, with the plans reviewed monthly with the head of customer success.

skills.text: Coordinates renewals with the account executive, with pricing decisions staying with the account executive, and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Coordinated renewals with the account executives through the renewal tracker; the pricing decisions were the account executives', and the tracker records which preparation was mine.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish that the candidate runs quarterly business reviews, presents findings to executives, tracks adoption, coordinates renewals, and documents open items. They do not establish the candidate's ability to present with authority or handle escalations.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate meets several requirements but lacks evidence for presenting with authority and handling escalations.
